name: gideonai-mail-desk
description: Two-way mail desk over stdlib IMAP and SMTP. Converse with your agent by mail, replies thread back, and results arrive in the same conversation. No streaming; approvals answer by reply token.
author: Gideon

x-meta.label: IMAP Host
x-meta.help: IMAP server hostname for inbound mail (e.g. imap.gmail.com).

x-meta.label: IMAP Port
x-meta.help: 993 for implicit SSL (the default), 143 for plaintext.

x-meta.label: IMAP Username
x-meta.help: IMAP login, usually the full email address.

x-meta.label: IMAP SSL
x-meta.help: Connect with implicit TLS (IMAP4_SSL). Leave on for port 993.

x-meta.label: Folder
x-meta.help: IMAP folder to poll. Polled read-only — your mail is never marked read.

x-meta.label: SMTP Host
x-meta.help: SMTP server hostname for outbound mail (e.g. smtp.gmail.com).

x-meta.label: SMTP Port
x-meta.help: 587 for STARTTLS (the default), 465 for implicit SSL.

x-meta.label: SMTP Username
x-meta.help: SMTP login, usually the full email address.

x-meta.label: SMTP Security
x-meta.help: starttls (587), ssl (465), or plain. A failed STARTTLS aborts the send — it never falls back to plaintext.

x-meta.label: Mailbox Address
x-meta.help: The address this channel sends as and receives at. Defaults to the IMAP username. Also the self-message filter's anchor.

x-meta.label: Poll Interval (s)
x-meta.help: How often to check for new mail. Clamped to 10-3600s.

x-meta.label: Inbound Activation
x-meta.help: always answers every paired sender; off disables inbound while keeping outbound delivery.
